---
title: middleware
description: Run code before a request is completed.
---

Middleware runs before a request reaches a route. It lives at the project root
in `middleware.ts` and exports one function and an optional matcher. This
fixture path is the one the committed rule table marks as superseded, so the
label must come from the rule and not from the path default (MIDDLEWARE-MARK).

## Usage

Export a function that returns a response or calls `next()`. The matcher limits
which requests enter the function; without a matcher every request pays the
cost. Middleware runs on the edge runtime, so it cannot open a database socket
or read the file system (USAGE-MARK).

## Matcher

The matcher accepts path patterns and runs only on matching requests. A matcher
that misses nested routes is the usual cause of a middleware that "does not
run", which is why the synthetic forum answer for this topic is labelled stale
(MATCHER-MARK).
